text:
rajesh_partners: FYI QuantBridge just pushed the final onboarding bundle for q-llamaX-v2-8bit. They attached a manifest and a small test tarball. Need quick triage on redistribution + marketplace listing window.

ingrid_legal: Thanks rajesh. First pass: I need to confirm redistribution rights for quantized artifacts (8-bit weights) and whether their CLA restricts re-hosting on marketplaces. Do we have the vendor CLA + the original model license?

matt_infra: I'll pull the bundle into a staging Dedicated node and run the quant profile. If kernels are compatible we can validate perf by EOD. Any specific sequence lengths to test?

sarah_pm: Marketing is asking about a joint announcement window. Can we target Wed next week? That means legal + marketplace approvals by EoW. Is that realistic? :eyes:

tom_ops: Packaging checklist I usually run through:```
# packaging checklist
- validate manifest.json
- run perf smoke (512/1024 tokens)
- build 8-bit runtime artifact (quantized.tar.gz)
- attach provenance.txt + checksum
- sign artifact with our release key
```

lisa_marketing: We should plan an AWS Marketplace SKU + a co-marketing blog. Also want to include CloudMeld SI in the joint announcement (they're doing the integration). Need revenue share/placement terms for Marketplace.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace ingestion created: MB-4321. Status: queued for manifest validation. ETA: 48h.

ingrid_legal: Quick notes from legal:
- If the upstream license is permissive (MIT/Apache) redistribution of quantized weights is usually okay but we need explicit attribution and provenance.
- For dual-license or restricted models, we need a signed redistribution addendum from QuantBridge that mentions: quantized weights, marketplace hosting, SI redistribution rights.
- Also confirm export control matrix (some quantized models still need EAR checks).

rajesh_partners: QuantBridge said in thread they accept marketplace hosting but want a small attribution block and a usage telemetry clause (opt-in). I'll ask them to sign our standard distributor addendum.

matt_infra: Quick perf note: in staging q-llamaX-v2-8bit hits 18–20 tok/s on a g4dn-like setup with our 8-bit kernels. Memory looks fine. I'll push a quant profile and KV-cache test in the next hour.

sarah_pm: If legal can get the addendum by Thu morning we can still make Wed announcement? timeline feels tight. If not, propose soft-launch: announce SI partnership and marketplace listing "coming soon".

ingrid_legal: I'll draft the addendum now and post it here for review. Draft will include: redistribution rights for derived quantized artifacts, permitted resellers (Redwood + SI partners), telemetry opt-in text, and an indemnity carve-out for third-party rehosts.

lisa_marketing: Also need logos, short boilerplate (50–70 words), and a quote from QuantBridge. Can someone confirm who on their side will sign off on marketing assets?

rajesh_partners: I'll ping Asha (QuantBridge bizdev) now for marketing signoff and to request the signed addendum.

marketplace-bot: MB-4321 manifest validation: warnings:
- missing provenance.txt (recommended)
- checksum mismatch on quantized.tar.gz? please verify and re-upload.

tom_ops: Re-uploaded checksum and added provenance.txt (see attached). Also included minimal provenance: git commit, builder image, quant recipe.

matt_infra: Re-ran perf after rebuilt artifact, stable 19.5 tok/s on 1024 seq. KV-cache warmups look correct. No kernel falls back to CPU.

ingrid_legal: Draft addendum posted (see snippet):
"QuantBridge Distributor Addendum: Quantized artifacts (8-bit, 4-bit) may be hosted, cached, and redistributed by Redwood Inference and authorized SI partners. Redistribution scope: hosting on cloud marketplaces, bundling with SI offerings. Telemetry: only aggregate opt-in usage stats will be collected unless customer opts-in to detailed telemetry. Export controls: parties will comply with applicable export law; QuantBridge to declare EAR status."

rajesh_partners: Great. Action items: 
- rajesh_partners: get signed addendum from Asha by Thu AM
- ingrid_legal: finalize addendum and confirm wording for telemetry by Wed EOD
- matt_infra: finish perf/e2e tests and upload perf report to MB ticket by EOD
- tom_ops: confirm packaging + signed checksum uploaded (done)
- lisa_marketing: draft blog + co-announcement copy; hold until legal signoff but prepare assets
- sarah_pm: prepare announcement cadence; plan soft-launch fallback if addendum delayed

lisa_marketing: I'll prepare assets and a short hero image mock; ping me when Asha confirms.

rajesh_partners: pinged Asha — she says she can sign the addendum but needs to check the telemetry clause, should have an answer by tomorrow morning PST.

ingrid_legal: If telemetry clause is the blocker we can offer a two-tier option: marketplace listing with aggregate opt-in only, and a premium SI bundle for customers who opt into detailed telemetry (requires explicit customer consent).

sarah_pm: That sounds workable. We'll proceed with market listing conditional on addendum. If signed by Thu AM we keep Wed announce slot, else push to next week and do soft-launch.

rajesh_partners: Thanks everyone — I'll update MB-4321 with the signed addendum once received and post the final timeline. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: MB-4321 updated: manifest validated. Next step: security scan (approx 24h).
